events.name: Jack's Lantern Trail
events.info: Your ticket time is when all guests for that time slot begin entering the Iroquois Amphitheater. Please allow an additional 30 to 45 minutes to reach the trail entrance. The trail opens at dusk, typically at 7:30 PM at the beginning of the season, but as early as 6:50 toward the end of the season, depending on daylight and weather. WALKING DISTANCE = From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is a 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater by that time will be allowed onto the trail.
events.pleaseNote: Journey through an enchanted forest where magic awaits around every bend. Marvel at thousands of intricately carved jack-o'-lanterns and immerse yourself in an adventure that delights guests of every age. Your ticket time indicates when the line for that time slot will begin entering the Amphitheater. We will open the trail at dusk, which is the best time to enjoy the glow. The opening time for the trail varies depending on weather and daylight hours as the month progresses. From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday, and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater at closing will be allowed through the trail. Free parking is available on-site.

events.info: Experience the official "Outlander" in-concert event! A live orchestra performs Bear McCreary's acclaimed score, curated by showrunner Matthew B. Roberts, while highlights from eight seasons illuminate the screen. From Craigh na Dun to the New World, relive Claire and Jamie's journey as Scotland's Celtic sound takes the spotlight. Outlander in Concert celebrates the show's rich heritage, the timeless romance between Claire and Jamie, and the sweeping landscapes that made us fall in love. Premiering in Scotland; the heart and home of "Outlander," Echoes of The Highlands will fill the air, reminding us that this is not the end... but just the beginning. Doors open at 7:00pm. May contain mature themes no suitable for all ages.
events.pleaseNote: Be advised this show may contain mature themes not suitable for all ages. We recommend parental guidance for children in attendance. Doors open at 7:00pm. All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges. Everyone, regardless of age including babes in arms, must purchase a ticket. Dates, times, prices and Artist are subject to change without notice. Be sure to check the venue website closer to your event date for the latest information. Use of personal cell phones for pictures are allowed at the discretion of the show. No Professional Cameras, Flash Photography, Audio or Video Recording of any kind are permitted.

events.info: Your ticket time is when all guests for that time slot begin entering the Iroquois Amphitheater. Please allow an additional 30 to 45 minutes to reach the trail entrance. The trail opens at dusk, typically at 7:30 PM at the beginning of the season, but as early as 6:50 toward the end of the season, depending on daylight and weather. WALKING DISTANCE = From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is a 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater by that time will be allowed onto the trail.
events.pleaseNote: Journey through an enchanted forest where magic awaits around every bend. Marvel at thousands of intricately carved jack-o'-lanterns and immerse yourself in an adventure that delights guests of every age. Your ticket time indicates when the line for that time slot will begin entering the Amphitheater. We will open the trail at dusk, which is the best time to enjoy the glow. The opening time for the trail varies depending on weather and daylight hours as the month progresses. From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday, and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater at closing will be allowed through the trail. Free parking is available on-site.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Iroquois Amphitheater Box Office Hours 1PM-6PM on Thursdays, 11AM-4PM on Fridays. Note: On show nights the box office will open two hours prior to the scheduled show time that evening.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa and Mastercard are accepted at the box office.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Pick up Will Call two hours prior to scheduled performance time at the Iroquois Box Office. Must have actual credit card, a picture ID and your confirmation number to pick up your tickets.

venues.parkingDetail: There is free available parking at Iroquois Amphitheater.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Wheelchair accessible seating can be handled at the Iroquois Amphitheater Box Office or by calling your local Ticketmaster Charge-by-phone line. Audio Description, Caption Theatre, & ASL is available on the following scheduled nights:

generalInfo.generalRule: Umbrellas, Cameras, recording devices, coolers and food items are prohibited at the Amphitheater.
generalInfo.childRule: Our Child Policy is that everyone three and over will need a ticket for all ticketed performances. Those under three must sit in parent's lap for the duration of the performance. Some productions may require all patrons to have a ticket for entrance and will be announced as such.
